raw_lines: **Proof technique:** split the product into its finite and archimedean parts; the finite part is the reciprocal of $|N_{K/\mathbb Q}(x)|$ by unique factorisation and the ideal-norm formulas, and the archimedean part is $|N_{K/\mathbb Q}(x)|$ by the embedding formula for the norm.
findings.symptom: The Proof technique is rendered in uppercase as plain text; its dollar-delimited TeX remains literal (including $|N_{K/\mathbb Q}(x)|$) instead of typesetting.
